author: GamingBolt
description:
Here we are at part thirteen of our Resident Evil recap, where we are going to cover the events of Resident Evil 5, one of the most significant games as far as the series’ overarching story is concerned. 

Not only does RE5 see the paths of longtime series veterans like Chris Redfield, Jill Valentine, and Albert Wesker, it also brings resolution to several major long running arcs.
title: Resident Evil 5 - What The Hell Happened? - Before You Play Resident Evil 9: Requiem | Full Story

author: GamingBolt
description:
Sons of Sparta is a fantastic platformer, and a true breath of fresh air for the genre. The fact that it’s on the shorter side for the genre, coming in at around 10 hours, also helps. There is a certain lightheartedness that comes with the setting despite its brutal and violent combat. 

Both Kratos and Deimos’ conversations often go on for slightly too long, but it’s still quite fun to hear their banter every now and then. Combine that with excellent combat that peaks during its epic boss battles, and you’ve got a thrilling new way to take in this Spartan tale.
title: God of War: Sons of Sparta Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert is shaping up to be a gift that keeps on giving, with its latest showcase focused on the things you get to do in Pywell being quite interesting in a myriad of ways. Klyff's homelands are shaping up to be a living, breathing world full of mystery while also bringing more mundane aspects of its citizen’s lives to the fore.

Even better is the fact that it all seems balanced so well that you might find yourself wandering quite far from the destination you had in mind when you set out. There's a lot to do in Pywell, and it's going to take all of the Greymanes to let Klyff get to it all.
title: Crimson Desert - 15 NEW Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
